expected_findings.root_cause: _encode_files only treats an object as a file when isinstance(fp, _SupportsRead) succeeds, which a wrapper that exposes read through __getattr__ fails
expected_findings.failure_path: on Python 3.12 and later, isinstance against a runtime_checkable Protocol uses inspect.getattr_static and does not see attributes served by __getattr__; a file wrapper that proxies read() that way fails the check, is not read, and its contents never reach the multipart body; before 3.12 the Protocol check used hasattr and the removed `or hasattr(fp, 'read')` was redundant, so the defect only manifests on 3.12+
